summary:
Iteration 15 validated the new per-student tool-override and in-progress extra-time features. Backend pytest suite (5 tests) and full frontend E2E all PASSED.

Backend (test_examsecure_v15_tools_extratime.py, 5/5):
- PUT /api/sessions/{id}/tools with ['usito','bogus'] -> 200, tools_override=['usito'] (invalid filtered).
- GET /api/student/session merges tools_override into exam.settings.allowed_tools; e.g. wordreference override surfaces for a FRA401 session while preserving base tools ['antidote','usito'].
- session.events contains type 'tools_changed' after PUT.
- Non-owner teacher calling PUT /tools or /extra-time -> 404 (own_exam returns 404 when teacher_id does not match; acceptable per spec that allows 403/404).
- PUT /extra-time {extra_minutes:10} shifts GET /student/session deadline by 9.5-10.5 minutes.

Frontend E2E (headless Chromium, 2 contexts: student + teacher):
- Student joined FRA401, exam-timer before=59:58 (3598s), after +10 click=69:44 (4184s) => +586s (~9m46s, within next 5s poll). Timer increase confirmed.
- Teacher at /enseignant/examens/{FRA401}/resultats -> session-detail panels visible: extra-time-panel + session-tools-panel.
- add-extra-10-btn: toast + extra-minutes-input shows '10'. PASS.
- session-tool-antidote is disabled (already in exam, shows '(examen)'); session-tool-wordreference click triggered within ~5s a student toast 'Votre enseignant vous permet maintenant : WordReference' and tool-button-wordreference appeared in exam-tools-bar. Clicking it opens the tool panel; no violation. PASS.
- After student submit, teacher re-opens the submitted session: session-tools-panel is NOT rendered (session.status=='submitted' hides it). PASS.

Console: a couple of 401s on /api/auth/me on student page are pre-existing (unauthenticated AuthContext probe), unrelated.
critical_code_review_comments: server.exam_for_session merges tools_override into settings.allowed_tools without duplicates and preserves base order; clean.
session_tools filters payload against TOOLS allowlist (['usito','wordreference','antidote','wordq','lexibar']) before persisting - good.
own_exam raises 404 (not 403) for cross-teacher writes. Spec accepts either; consider 403 for clearer semantics distinguishing 'not found' from 'not yours'.

StudentExam poll compares allowed_tools via comma-joined string; relies on stable ordering returned by backend. Since backend concatenates (base + override) deterministically, this is fine; but if base ordering ever changes, a spurious toast could fire. Minor.
ExtraTime applies absolute extra_minutes via PUT; quick +5/+10/+15 buttons add to the local 'min' state before PUT, so repeated clicks accumulate - matches spec 'cumulative on current extra_minutes'.
SessionDetail only renders SessionTools when session.status==='in_progress' - confirmed hidden after submit.
test_credentials: Admin lynchs2757@gmail.com / Enseignant2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). An ephemeral teacher is created per module via POST /api/admin/users for the cross-teacher 404 check.
seed_data_creation: Each run creates a FRA401 session named 'TEST E2E <ts>' (student join) and 'TEST SDET <hex>' sessions from pytest; also one ephemeral teacher user 'test_sdet_<hex>@example.com' via admin. These are harmless but accumulate; cleanup not implemented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FRA401 exam id = 5b82923c-023b-4c34-bfbf-055aa36d822b (allowed_tools=['antidote','usito'], duration 60 min). Use 2 Playwright contexts to test student + teacher simultaneously. Student poll interval is 5s - wait >=6s after teacher mutations before asserting on student UI. tool-button-* only renders for web tools (usito, wordreference); desktop-only tools (antidote, wordq, lexibar) show as tool-badge-* when window.monExam.tools contains them.
rca of the issue: N/A - all features behave per spec.
